name: Metabase
description: Open source business intelligence and analytics platform. Create dashboards and explore data without writing SQL.
summary: Metabase is actively releasing updates across multiple stable branches simultaneously. The latest release is v0.65.2 (Open Source) / v1.65.2 (Enterprise), released on October 30, 2024, alongside patch releases for v0.64.4, v0.63.22, and v0.58.38. Detailed per-release changelogs are linked via GitHub's 'Full Changelog' comparison pages at https://github.com/metabase/metabase/releases. Both Open Source and Enterprise editions are distributed as Docker images and JAR downloads. Note: the provided changelog text does not include granular feature-level details for individual releases.

answers.What is the current license?: Dual: Open Source (AGPL v3) for the OSS edition; commercial/proprietary license for the Enterprise edition
answers.Is the project actively maintained?: Yes — multiple releases across several branches were published in October 2024 alone
answers.Is there a cloud-hosted version availabl: Yes — Metabase offers a managed cloud (Metabase Cloud) at metabase.com
answers.Does it support SSO and SAML authenticat: Yes — SSO and SAML are supported in the Enterprise edition
answers.What databases/data sources are supporte: PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, SQLite, SQL Server, Oracle, Redshift, BigQuery, Snowflake, Presto/Trino, Druid, MongoDB, SparkSQL, Vertica, and more via drivers

alternatives.name: Redash
alternatives.review: Open source, query-focused, simpler feature set.

alternatives.name: Apache Superset
alternatives.review: Apache-licensed, rich visualisation library, steeper setup curve.

alternatives.name: Grafana
alternatives.review: Primarily metrics/time-series but increasingly used for general BI.

alternatives.name: Hex
alternatives.review: Close source, enterprise focus, AI Analytics Platform for your whole team

alternatives.name: Tableau
alternatives.review: Tableau offers more advanced visualizations and enterprise features but is proprietary, expensive, and lacks Metabase's open-source self-hosting flexibility.

alternatives.name: Lightdash
alternatives.review: Lightdash is a strong open-source alternative tightly integrated with dbt, making it ideal for dbt-based workflows but less general-purpose than Metabase.
